name: Ca phe bot
summary: Cà phê bọt is a foam coffee, black or with milk, poured in Chợ Vinh. Drink the foam first, or stir it in.
origin: Chợ Vinh, on the 3 May 2025 VnExpress page. The 24 November 2022 city page names a city coffee and does not say it is this one.
howToEat: In the market hall, drink the foam first or stir it in. Black or with milk. A brand is not the point. The 24 November 2022 page’s coffee line does not say foam, so it is not folded into this cup. A price is Check on arrival. Market hours were not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Chợ Vinh. A door inside the hall was not printed. Check on arrival.
